hero.eyebrow: Environmental management and supervision for road projects
hero.title: All the environmental information for your road projects in one place
hero.description: RoadWatch OS centralizes projects, monitoring points, environmental measurements, alerts, incidents, evidence, and mitigation actions in a web platform designed to support environmental tracking and supervision.
solutions.title: Environmental management for road projects
solutions.subtitle: Tools to organize the environmental tracking of road projects and the supervision of consolidated information.
solutions.air.title: Environmental monitoring
solutions.air.description: Record and review air quality, noise, and basic water-quality measurements associated with each project's monitoring points.
solutions.noise.title: Environmental alerts
solutions.noise.description: Identification of measurements that approach or exceed configured environmental thresholds to facilitate preventive follow-up.
solutions.water.title: Incident management
solutions.water.description: Record and track environmental incidents, assignees, statuses, and corrective or mitigation actions.
solutions.wildlife.title: Evidence and reports
solutions.wildlife.description: Organize photographs, documents, records, and consolidated information for environmental reporting.
benefits.title: More organized environmental management
benefits.subtitle: Centralize the information needed to track projects, measurements, incidents, evidence, and reports.
benefits.shutdowns.title: Preventive environmental tracking
benefits.shutdowns.description: Identify measurements that require attention through configured thresholds.
benefits.audits.title: Centralized and traceable information
benefits.audits.description: Environmental records are organized and related to each project.
benefits.workflow.title: Organized incident management
benefits.workflow.description: Track assignees, statuses, evidence, and mitigation actions.
benefits.experts.title: Supervision of multiple projects
benefits.experts.description: Review consolidated information for environmental supervision and consulting firms.
features.title: RoadWatch OS features
features.subtitle: Features focused on recording, tracking, and reviewing environmental information for road projects.
features.connectivity: Web platform · Environmental management for roads
features.item1.title: Projects and monitoring points
features.item1.description: Organize road projects and their monitoring points to review the environmental information associated with each one.
features.item2.title: Environmental measurements and indicators
features.item2.description: Record and review air, noise, and water measurements, with history and alerts based on configured thresholds.
features.item3.title: Incidents and mitigation actions
features.item3.description: Manage environmental incidents in a Kanban board with assignees, statuses, comments, and mitigation actions.
features.item4.title: Documents, evidence, and reports
features.item4.description: Organize photographic evidence, documents, and follow-up information for environmental reporting.
